lines: The Shinobi Snakes and Shinobi Bears under Sakura-sensei's command were tough.
But the power of Yukikaze's lightning was overwhelming. And with the coordination of Hebiko, Shikanosuke, and me, we had somehow managed to knock them all out.
Yep yep, that was some good exercise before class.
Yukikaze was smiling from the bottom of her heart. She looked like she was having a lot of fun, being able to get her body in motion.
You're pretty good too, Hebiko-chan. Those octopus tentacles? They look pretty convenient, and I was surprised when you suddenly spat out ink.
Shikanosuke, you should've told me that you're also a Lightning Art user like me! You were sending out radio waves to distract them, but can't you make those more powerful?
N-No, mine is not Lightning, it's just an Electric Art, and I can't make it more powerful. I'm not the same as you at all, Yukikaze-san.
Why do you put "-san" on my name? We're in the same grade, aren't we. It's weird if you keep being so scared of meー
...Whew, for goodness' sake. And about you, Fuma.
Yukikaze complimented Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and then she made a point of turning toward me.
I wondered if you were lazing around again, but you were giving orders to Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke, weren't you?
That's what you were doing with those weird finger signs, right?
But you're just going to lead from behind? You're not going to fight yourself?
Yukikaze put her hands on her hips and peered at me as if I were stupid.
In contrast, I puffed out my chest.
I'm not bragging, but I can't use Ninja Arts and my grades in martial arts are also not great.
If I were to join the fight, I'd just get in the way. So I just concentrate on giving orders.
Yeah, that really is nothing to brag about.
But at least Fuma-chan's leadership skills are amazing.
Fuma-chan knows Heberybody's strengths and gives the right orders depending on the situation. Right, Shikanosuke-chan?
Well, it was Fuma who found a new use for my abilities that I thought weren't suitable for combat...
Thanks to him, even I've been stuck having to participate in battles, uwuwuh...
Hey, that's not something to complain about~
Hmm, these two seem to approve of you.
Yukikaze said, still with a look of doubt on her face.
